base_prompt: I want to keep a small balcony pleasant, but I dislike spending weekends on maintenance. Suggest priorities for arranging the space. Please answer in roughly 160 words.
text: Prioritize comfort, durability, and easy cleaning rather than filling every corner. Start with one compact, weather-resistant seating piece, such as a folding chair or slim bench with washable, quick-drying cushions. Add a small folding or nesting table that can be moved easily and stored when unused. Keep the floor mostly open so sweeping takes minutes; an outdoor rug can add warmth, but choose a lightweight, mold-resistant version that dries quickly. For greenery, select a few hardy plants suited to the balcony’s sun and wind conditions instead of many demanding varieties. Use large self-watering planters, which dry out more slowly and reduce watering frequency, and group them near a water source. Favor evergreen foliage over plants that constantly drop flowers or leaves. Use vertical space with one secure wall planter or narrow shelf, while avoiding crowded railings. Add warm solar or rechargeable lighting with an automatic timer. Finally, provide a weatherproof storage box for cushions and tools, and keep decorations minimal, sturdy, and easy to wipe clean.
